result.topic_en: Calculations transforming a second-order linear differential equation in the variable $y'$ (with cubic coefficient $y'-(\varkappa+1)y'^2+\varkappa y'^3$) by the substitution $\sqrt{1-y'}=\frac{z+1/z}{2}$, $\sqrt{y'}\,i=\frac{z-1/z}{2}$, with a power-series/recursive expansion in $\varkappa$, plus some formulas involving $\varepsilon$ and $t$; a dated signature note "10. Mai 1856" with Riemann's name.
result.transcription:
$t=\alpha_2\varepsilon-\alpha_1 \quad t'=\varepsilon^2(\alpha_2\varepsilon-\alpha_1)$
$\frac{\partial t}{\partial x} \quad \varepsilon^2\frac{\partial t}{\partial x}+2\varepsilon\frac{\partial\varepsilon}{\partial x}t$
$t'\frac{\partial t}{\partial x} \quad t'\frac{\partial t}{\partial x}+2\frac{\partial\log\varepsilon}{\partial x}tt'$
$\frac{(\sqrt{1-y'}+\sqrt{y'}i)^{2k}+(\sqrt{1-y'}-\sqrt{y'}i)^{2k}}{2}$
$\frac{(\sqrt{1-y'}+\sqrt{y'}i)^{2k}-(\sqrt{1-y'}-\sqrt{y'}i)^{2k}}{4ki}$
$(1-y')^k+2k(1-y')^{k-\frac12}y'^{\frac12}i$
$\frac{\partial y'}{y'\sqrt{1-y'}}$
$4ki \quad \frac{\partial y'i}{\sqrt{(1-y')y'}}=2\frac{\partial\sqrt{y'}i}{\sqrt{1-y'}}=2\partial\log z$
$\sqrt{1-y'}=\frac{z+\frac1z}{2} \quad \sqrt{y'}i=\frac{z-\frac1z}{2}$
[-$1-y'=\ldots$-] [-$\ldots$-]
$z+\frac1z \quad \partial\log z$
$y'(1-\varkappa y')(1-y')=y'-(\varkappa+1)y'^2+\varkappa y'^3$
$(y'-(\varkappa+1)y'^2+\varkappa y'^3)\frac{\partial^2u}{\partial y'^2}+(-(\varkappa+1)y'+\varkappa\frac32 y'^2)\frac{\partial u}{\partial y'}-(\sigma\overline{\sigma+\tfrac12}\varkappa y'-kk)u=0$
$(y'-(\varkappa+1)y'^2+\varkappa y'^3)\frac{\partial^2u^{(n)}}{\partial y'^2}+(-(\varkappa+1)y'+\varkappa\frac32 y'^2)\frac{\partial u^{(n)}}{\partial y'}-(\sigma\overline{\sigma+\tfrac12}\varkappa y'-kk)u^{(n)}$
$+n\left[(-y'^2+y'^3)\frac{\partial^2u^{(n-1)}}{\partial y'^2}+(-y'+\frac32y'^2)\frac{\partial u^{(n-1)}}{\partial y'}-\sigma(\sigma+\tfrac12)y'u^{(n-1)}\right]=0$
$y' \quad \sqrt{-1+y'}$
$-\frac{\partial^2u^{(n)}}{(\partial\log z)^2}+4kku^{(n)}+n\left(\frac{z-\frac1z}{2}\right)^2\frac{\partial^2u^{(n-1)}}{4\partial\log z^2}+\left(\frac{z^2-\frac1{z^2}}{2^2}\right)\frac{\partial u^{(n-1)}}{\partial\log z}+\sigma(\sigma+\tfrac12)\frac{(z-\frac1z)^2}{4}u^{(n-1)}$
$z^{2k}$
$-z^{2k}\frac{\partial u^{(n)}}{\partial\log z}+2kz^{2k}u^{(n)}$

methods.what: Factorization of the cubic coefficient of the differential equation
Second-order linear ODE in $y'$ with parameters $\varkappa,\sigma,k$
Recursive equations for the coefficients $u^{(n)}$ of an expansion in $\varkappa$ (obtained by differentiating n times with respect to $\varkappa$)
Substitution uniformizing the square roots via a variable $z$
Zeroth-order solutions as even/odd combinations of powers (Chebyshev-type)
Transformed recursion in the variable $\log z$
